articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can simultaneously process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement over GPT-5 on complex software engineering tasks, with significantly reduced hallucination rates on factual retrieval. The model is available through the API with a new streaming architecture that cuts time-to-first-token latency by half.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored a verified 92% on a curated set of International Mathematical Olympiad problems, surpassing the previous best AI result by a significant margin. The system uses a novel chain-of-verification architecture that self-checks proof steps before proceeding, dramatically reducing logical errors in multi-step formal reasoning. Researchers say the approach generalizes to theorem proving and formal verification of software correctness.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot has started operating in select third-party logistics warehouses outside Tesla's own factories, marking the first commercial deployment to external customers. The robots handle bin picking, palletizing, and inventory scanning with a reported 99.1% grasp success rate using updated tactile sensor arrays. Tesla says the units operate autonomously for 16-hour shifts with remote human oversight and plans to scale to dozens of partner sites by Q1 2027.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Electric with Real-Time Adaptive Locomotion Over Unstructured Terrain
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics showcased the latest Atlas Electric platform featuring a new real-time terrain adaptation system that uses onboard LiDAR and learned locomotion policies to traverse rubble, mud, and steep inclines without pre-mapping. The system was demonstrated at a simulated disaster response site where Atlas navigated a collapsed building interior entirely autonomously. Hyundai indicated the technology will feed into commercial inspection robots for construction and energy infrastructure.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source LLaMA 4 with 1 Trillion Parameters Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta publicly released LLaMA 4, its largest open-weight language model at over one trillion parameters, under an Apache 2.0 license with no commercial usage restrictions. The model uses a mixture-of-experts architecture requiring only 140B active parameters per forward pass, making it feasible to run on a single 8×H100 node. Early independent benchmarks show it is competitive with leading proprietary models on coding, reasoning, and multilingual tasks, reshaping the open-source AI landscape.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N14G process, based on gate-all-around nanosheet transistors at the 1.4nm-class node, has entered high-volume manufacturing several months ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node delivers approximately 25% improved performance and 35% lower power consumption compared to the N2 node. The accelerated timeline is expected to benefit next-generation AI accelerator chips from major fabless customers including NVIDIA and Apple in 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval to Expand Brain-Computer Interface Trials to 50 Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to expand its N1 brain-computer interface clinical trial from the initial cohort to 50 patients with severe paralysis, following positive safety and efficacy data from the first year of implantation. Participants demonstrated sustained high-bandwidth cursor and device control at over 100 bits per minute with no serious adverse events reported. The expansion will include new patient populations with ALS and high spinal cord injuries, moving the technology closer to broader clinical availability.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Scale Humanoid Robot Deployment to Full Assembly Line Integration
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 02 humanoid robots are now integrated across multiple stations on a BMW assembly line in Spartanburg, South Carolina, moving beyond the initial pilot phase. The robots perform component insertion, quality inspection, and material handling tasks alongside human workers with coordination managed by a centralized fleet orchestration system. Figure reports a 3x improvement in task completion reliability since the pilot began, driven by continuous over-the-air policy updates from real-world operational data.
